exceptions.reason: Denial of service (an unhandled error crashes the process) when a response lists too many content-encodings; no data exposure. undici 8.10.2 is an exact dependency of every published Pi host (1.3.0 and 1.4.0), installed globally, so no Piagent change can update it; 8.12.2 fixes it. Remove when a Pi host carries undici >= 8.12.2.
Denial of service (unbounded memory) in undici's EventSource parser fed by a hostile server; no data exposure. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2.
Subresource Integrity check bypassed with a non-lowercase algorithm token; Pi does not fetch with integrity metadata. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2.

Cache poisoning and cross-user disclosure through cross-origin redirects in undici's cache; Pi does not share an HTTP cache between users. Pinned by the Pi host as above (8.10.2 in 1.3.0 and 1.4.0); fixed in undici 8.12.2.

TLS certificate validation bypassed when an Agent drops its tls options; affects callers that pass custom tls settings to an undici Agent. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2. Owner accepted on 2026-10-28 to keep releases going; revisit as soon as a Pi host carries undici >= 8.12.2.
Denial of service through a TLS 1.2 certificate-changing renegotiation by a hostile server; no data exposure. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2.
Denial of service from unbounded automatic PONG buffering in the WebSocket client fed by a hostile server; no data exposure. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2.
Denial of service from an unhandled exception in the decompress interceptor; no data exposure. Pinned by the Pi host as above; fixed in undici 8.12.2.
